fieldValues.title: Record fieldValues is a name-keyed object
fieldValues.normative_statement: A Tier-2 `Record`'s `fieldValues` MUST be a JSON object. Each key MUST equal the `Field.name` of a Field in the effective field set of the Record's `typeId`@`typeVersion`. Unknown keys MUST be rejected; the projected schema asserts `additionalProperties: false`. (RFC-039 [R1])
